name.label: Name
name.taken: A role with this name already exists

isDefault.label: Default role for self-registration
isDefault.description: When open registration is enabled, new users are automatically assigned this role. Only one role can be the default.

delete.title: Delete role
delete.message: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

admin.title: Admin role
admin.description: This role holds every permission, including those of modules added later. It can't be edited, deleted or assigned to anyone.

ceiling.title: Above your role
ceiling.description: This role has permissions your own role doesn't have, so you can't edit it, change its permissions or delete it.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.notGrantable: Your own role doesn't have this permission, so you can't grant it.
permissions.requirementNotGrantable: Your own role can't grant {{list}}, which this permission requires.

missing.description: Checked permissions need the ones highlighted below. Check them, or uncheck what needs them, to save.
missing.someNotGrantable: Your own role can't grant some of the highlighted permissions: uncheck what needs them to save.

errors.default_role: The default registration role cannot be deleted. Make another role the default first.
errors.role_in_use: This role still has users. Move them to another role first.
errors.role_not_editable: This role has permissions your own role doesn't have, so you can't change or delete it.
errors.permissions_not_grantable: You can't grant permissions your own role doesn't have.
errors.missing_required_permissions: Some permissions need others that aren't checked. Check them too.
errors.admin_role_locked: The admin role can't be edited or deleted.
